# Official AP4M hackathon toolkit

`x402.mjs` is the same unchanged file as `apps/demo/vendor/ap4m/x402.mjs`, downloaded from
https://hackathon.ap4m.build/sdk/ap4m-x402.mjs. The issuer image bundles it for `PAYOUT_RAIL=ap4m`.

SHA-256: `ec4ed75def98673df75a736f6a2514b74ba1ddd26c16faad5c37160246435ce6`.

`x402.d.mts` declares the three functions the issuer calls. It is ours, not part of the toolkit.
